result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but a few elements look clipped or crowded, especially horizontally scrollable content and content behind the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The restaurant feed content is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar. The second card in the “Popular right now” section is cut off at the bottom of the screen, making the layout feel obstructed.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards are not covered by the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category chip row is visibly clipped on the right edge, with only part of the next chip showing. This can look accidental rather than like an intentional carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding, a fade indicator, or ensure the partially visible chip is spaced more deliberately to communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel item on the right is heavily cropped, including the restaurant name, which makes the row feel visually cut off.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel item width/spacing or add a clear horizontal-scroll affordance so partial cards look intentional.
